## Screen recording

Every UI change, feature, or bug fix needs a short recording (15 to 60 seconds) that reviewers can watch inline. Fixes and UI changes get a before/after clip; a new feature gets one demo clip. Follow the steps in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md#screen-recordings). Never commit the video file.
